tei:div.tei:p: bde ba can du bgrod pa'i smon lam ni/ maṅga laṃ swasti bha wantu/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum gzigs pa po// mchog gi yon tan ma lus mthar phyin pa'i// zla med brnyes pa de dang dam pa'i chos// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal// mtha' yas nam mkha'i mtha' klas zhing rgya mtsho// mtha' dag sku yi sprul pas snang bar mdzad// mtha' yas 'od mnga' thub chen tshe dpag med// mtha' med 'khor ba'i 'gro ba kun la khyab// kun mkhyen rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od// kun nas rab rdzogs ye shes 'od 'phro bas// kun rtog srid pa'i mun stug sna tshogs pa// kun sel rnam 'dren gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od phreng gsal bas zhing kun khyab mdzad de// ye shes spyan gyis cung zad gzigs pas kyang*// bdud sde'i dpung tshogs ma lus zhi mdzad pa// dpag med sku yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// srid dang zhi ba rab spangs rnam grol sku// ngo bo nyid kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gang gang 'dul ba de la der ston pa'i// mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun rnam 'byed yan lag drug cu yi// gsung gcig gis kyang phyogs dus thams cad du// sems can dbang po'i rim pa ji bzhin 'jug /dpag med gsung gi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las rab 'das kyang*// 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i yang dag tshig /gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas// legs pa'i lam mchog ston la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin 'od gsal mkha' ltar mi dmigs kyang*// rnam pa kun ldan ye shes rol pa yis// shes bya ji snyed mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// dpag med thugs kyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun ngo bo nyid kyis nyer zhi zhing*// ma 'gags snang ba rab tu bkra ba gang*// khyod kyis gzigs pa'ang rnam dag zhi ba dang*// de bzhin kun tu gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig 'gro ba'i yid bzhin nyer 'tsho'i gnas// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes dpag med stobs// thugs rje'i phrin las dpag tu med pa yi// 'od dpag med la rtag par phyag 'tshal lo// dngos dang yid kyis sprul pa'i lus longs spyod// yongs su ma bzung nam mkha'i mthar thug pa// blo yis blangs te bde bar gshegs rnams mchod// dman la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag dang sems can kun gyi sdig pa'i las// nyes par gyur gang mthol zhing bshags par bgyi// slan chad nam yang bgyid par ma gyur cig

/las kyi sgrib pa'ang gtan du zad byed shog /rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi dge la rjes yi rang*// gang yang phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad la// theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// bskal pa rgya mtsho dpag tu med par yang*// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ci yod pa// gzhan phan don phyir byang chub chen por bsngo// ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob bar// skye ba 'di dang ma 'ongs thams cad du// bla ma dam pas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /byang chub sems ni nam du'ang nyams ma gyur// rigs gzugs longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yi// dal 'byor mchog thob chos ldan grogs dang bcas// sangs rgyas bstan la rim bzhin slob pa dang*// 'dun dang brtson 'grus bag yod ldan gyur cig /ngan song gsum sogs mi bzad 'khor ba yi// mi khom 'jig rten rnams su skye 'gyur las// gang de tshe 'di nyid la rab smin nas// lan grangs gzhan du myong bar ma gyur cig /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab thabs mkhas rmad byung dang*// smon lam stobs dang ye shes rgya mtsho yi// spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /lus dang de bzhin srog la'ang ltos med par// sems las rung zhing dben par rang rgyud dul// lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i chos kyis 'byor// brtse ldan rtag tu shes bzhin ldan gyur cig /'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang mya ngan 'das// kun rtog de bzhin nyid gang ye shes te// gcig dang du ma'i bdag nyid las 'das pa'i// chos nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros ldan gyur cig /gang yang rten 'byung zab mo'i tshul gnas pa// nges don mthar thug spros bral chos kyi sku// stobs sogs yon tan ye shes phrin las sogs// bde gshegs chos la thogs med 'jug gyur cig

/gang du 'gro blo mngon par dga' gyur pa'i// yid lus spyod pa rnam par dag pa dang*// dbyangs snyan ngag gis chos tshul rgya mtsho ston// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod dang mtshungs par shog /ji srid de lta'i yon tan ma thob bar// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi// 'chi med tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par nye ba na// bde gshegs sras dang bcas pas byin brlabs te// 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs nas// lha dang lha mo dpag tu med pa yis// sna tshogs mchod pas bdag gi sngun bsu zhing*// rang snang dri med chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin// rnam dag bde ba can gyi zhing khams der// bde chen sems kyis bde blag bgrod gyur cig /zhing der dmar ser 'od kyi phung po'i dbus// rab mang rin chen padma'i ze'u 'bru la// dge slong bye ba 'bum dang thabs gcig pa'i// chos rje 'od dpag med pa mthong gyur cig /rgyal sras tshogs kyis yongs bskor bcom ldan 'das// thun mtshams 'char ka'i nyin byed ltar dmar ba// 'od 'bar blta bas mi ngoms de mthong nas// byang chub chen po'i lung bstan thob gyur cig /dge tshogs legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras// ngo mtshar yongs rdzogs dpal dang ldan pa'i lus// dpag med sprul nas bcom ldan 'das de la// bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos shis pa brjod gyur cig /byams chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang kun tu bzang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob la sogs// rgyal sras rnams dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// rnam thar tshul la mnyam par 'jug gyur cig /rnam thar rgya mtsho sgyu ma ltar sbyong bas// theg mchog rgya mtsho'i thabs rnams kun bzung ste// ye shes rgya mtsho'i rtogs pa rab thob nas// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro kun sgrol gyur cig /zhing khams rgya mtsho rtag tu sbyong ba dang*// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho dag ni spel bar byed// sems can rgya mtsho rab tu smin byas te// smon lam rgya mtsho rnams ni 'grub gyur cig

/ji ltar sngon gyi bde bar gshegs rnams kyis// thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad stobs ci 'dra ba// de ltar bdag gis sems can ma lus tshogs// myur du sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog / ces 'od dpag tu med pa la bstod pa yan lag bdun pa smon lam dang bcas pa 'di/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pas mdo smad kyi sa'i cha rma chu'i 'gram du sbyar ba'o// //
